annotations.title: Create Statutory Filing or Credit Report Order

description: Create a paid order for an official Hong Kong Companies Registry (Cap. 622) / Business Registration Office (Cap. 310) statutory PDF document OR a 360° Commercial Credit & Due Diligence Report (`CREDIT_REPORT` HK$ 499 / `CREDIT_DEEP` HK$ 880) — ONLY call this after user confirmation. Works WITHOUT an API key! Payment routing is region-aware when `pay_method="auto"`: overseas & ChatGPT users receive Stripe Checkout ONLY (`checkout_url` + `/en/` `web_cashier_url`); Mainland China users receive Alipay + 3-in-1 Web Cashier; Hong Kong users receive AlipayHK + `/tc/` Web Cashier. For ICRIS filings pass `barcode` OR `identifier` + `doc_code` (`NAR1`, `NNC1`, `A&A`, `ND2A`, `BRC`, `EBRE`); for due diligence reports pass `identifier` + `doc_code="CREDIT_REPORT"` (or `"CREDIT_DEEP"`). Earn +10 bonus query credits automatically upon payment.

api_key.description: Optional 86hc.com MCP API key (format: hkq_live_xxxx). Omit or leave empty to use the automatic Guest IP Trial Mode (3 free company detail queries/day + direct Stripe filing orders without a key). Free API key with 20 daily company queries available at https://www.86hc.com/user

barcode.description: Authentic ICRIS document barcode obtained from get_company_filings or batch_get_company_details. Omit when ordering CREDIT_REPORT / CREDIT_DEEP, or provide identifier + doc_code to auto-select the latest verified barcode.

company_name.description: Name or CR number of the company.

doc_code.description: Document or report code: NAR1 (Annual Return), NNC1 (Incorporation Form), ND2A (Change of Director/Secretary), A&A (Articles of Association), CI (Certificate of Incorporation), BRC (Duplicate of Valid Business Registration Certificate), EBRE (Electronic Extract of Business Register), CREDIT_REPORT (360° Commercial Credit & Due Diligence Report, HK$ 499), or CREDIT_DEEP (Comprehensive 4D Due Diligence Dossier, HK$ 880). Defaults to NAR1.

doc_name.description: Document title or form code (e.g. NAR1 Annual Return or CREDIT_REPORT).

email.description: Optional user email address to receive the official PDF download link.

identifier.description: Company CR number, 8-digit BRN, or company name.

pay_method.description: Payment routing mode: auto (default — Stripe ONLY for overseas/ChatGPT, Alipay for Mainland China, AlipayHK for Hong Kong), or explicit stripe / alipay / alipay_hk.

name: create_filing_order
